research_inputs.repo_rule: observability is an agent-legibility loop: local worktree-scoped logs, metrics, and traces must be queryable by Codex before broad repair claims
validation feedback must feed review-repair-validate loops instead of ending in manual JSON spelunking
workflow spans must connect tools, guardrails, custom work, and failures for debugging and later evals
trace/span parentage must make command, validator, tool, guardrail, and exporter work explainable
monitoring must support investigation, diagnosis, comparison, trend detection, and freshness checks
CLI observability must map latency, traffic, errors, and saturation into bounded metrics
wide structured events must carry enough bounded context to answer new repair questions
high-cardinality repair identifiers stay in events and spans, while metric labels stay bounded
logs, metrics, and traces must share stable semantic names so correlation is mechanical
traces and feedback must feed eval generation, ranked repair, validation, before/after comparison, and durable promotion
domain-agent improvement requires realistic tasks, expert-source feedback, rubrics, evals, repair ranking, and before/after proof
Rust command loops must preserve typed diagnostics, fast feedback, package authority, and observable failure paths
TypeScript setup and runtime surfaces must preserve governed boundaries and observable plugin activation
